messages:
ida: heads-up — i'm putting a short proposal in here for per-key routing + quota windows in the console. thinking this covers dedicated routing, project affinity, and a usable canary path for rollouts.

mohit: do you have the doc link? i want to check how this interacts with service-account -> project claim binding.

ida: quick snippet from the proposal:```yaml
route_rules:
  - match: key.prefix == "svc-"
    route: dedicated-eu
    quota:
      window: 1m
      tokens: 1000
  - match: org.id == "org_123" and model == "gptx"
    route: shared-gpu
    quota:
      window: 1h
      tokens: 50000
```
this would be evaluated in the auth-proxy before routing to runtime.

sasha: big concern: auth-proxy today strips origin claims coming from older SDKs. if we enforce these rules upstream we break attribution. we need a clear fallthrough header (e.g. X-Redwood-Origin) that proxies preserve. :warning:

kevin: can we avoid a new header? token introspection already returns claims, and runtime can evaluate. adding headers increases surface area for misrouting if proxies get misconfigured.

amanda: from telemetry POV we need token lineage events to track rollouts and quota impacts. propose adding event type `key.bind` and tagging with {key_id, org_id, project_id, route_rule_id, bucket}. this lets us build the console chart for per-key cost & fallback rates.

mohit: fwiw, for service accounts we should support ephemeral binding: SA token -> project claim with TTL. that simplifies rotation and keeps quotas accurate to the current binding.

ida: proposal for rollout path: 1) implement claim-preserve header + auth-proxy checks; 2) enable rule evaluation in staging only for requests with header `X-Redwood-Canary: true`; 3) collect `route_fallback_rate` + `quota_rejection` metrics; 4) after 2 weeks flip default.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: auth-proxy/staging -> canary @ 2026-03-22T06:00:00Z (ci/4567) :rocket:

kevin: +1 to rollout steps but add circuit-breaker: if fallback_rate > 2% for 5m trigger automatic rollback. also emit an alert to #eng-oncall.

amanda: i'll add telemetry schema and a mock console card for the per-key view (cost, token usage, route history, why-routed explanation). figma link: https://figma.redwood/internals/key-routing-card

mohit: UX note: console should show effective route per-key AND the last-applied rule id. helps debugging when org/project-level rules overlap.

ida: ok, i'll open an RFC and a small PR for auth-proxy to preserve origin claims + canary header. will include the YAML rule parser and a telemetry shim. thanks all. :thumbsup:
